The inline native WidgetShell reproduces the web shell chrome native-safe: loading -> dimmed skeleton box; error -> centered danger-toned message; else GlassPanel with a title-aware header (title present -> icon+uppercase muted title left + DataFreshness right; title absent/compact -> DataFreshness right-aligned only, matching the web shell's two branches) over the children body. DataFreshness is a native pill: relative 'updated' time with Updating…/Error/stale(warning) markers + a refresh Pressable wired to onRefresh.
